<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (major ion at m/z 183 with a characteristic M+2 peak indicating one chlorine) and the ¹H NMR data (a methyl singlet, a benzylic CH₂ singlet, and four aromatic protons in an ortho‑disubstituted pattern), the compound is best described as an ortho‑chlorophenylacetone: a ketone where a methyl‑carbonyl group is attached to a CH₂ that is bonded to a chlorobenzene ring. The corresponding SMILES string is “CC(=O)Cc1c(Cl)cccc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)Cc1c(Cl)cccc1</final_answer>
